newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen holding gains, eyes on RBA.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen holding gains, eyes on RBA.

text.p: *Stocks seen holding record highs, speculation of rate cut supports markets, banks in particular. "That may well underpin the market early in the day," Shaw's Jamie Spiteri said.
*Dow loses 33, blue chips trim gains made after U.S. Federal Reserve's no rate cut decision.
*ADRs: News Corp 18 (unch), BHP 29 7/8 (unch), WMC 25 3/4 (+1/8), National Australia Bank 72 (+7/8)

*Copper prices pushed higher still from US$2500 a tonne, closing up US$20 at US$2,526. Aluminium fell US$19 to US$1,633. Nickel prices bottomed after two-day slide, closing US$80 a tonne firmer at US$7,640. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
